acceptance_scope: We Work Remotely implemented and verified as an independently traceable global job-source adapter under MJ-REQ-017. Declares exact capabilities (CollectionStrategy.FEED: DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT) and disallows unsupported features (DIRECT_APPLICATION, APPLICATION_STATUS, SALARY). Normalizes multi-company job postings, location/remote metadata, skills, employment type, and title/description into canonical search semantics. Integrated into source registry and collection engine with deterministic contract fixtures and bounded live read-only verification.
acceptance_behavior: We Work Remotely adapter declares CollectionStrategy.FEED and supported capabilities: DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT.
Unsupported features including DIRECT_APPLICATION, APPLICATION_STATUS, and direct SALARY return False in accordance with capability contract.

Public RSS feed at https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss is parsed with rate limiting, monotonic clock intervals, timeout budgets, and status tracking (HEALTHY, SOURCE_TIMEOUT, SOURCE_NETWORK_ERROR, SOURCE_RATE_LIMITED, SOURCE_SERVER_ERROR, SOURCE_PAYLOAD_INVALID).
Per-job multi-company attribution is preserved using SourceCompany with identity parts ('wwr', company_slug) and URL domain.
Company and title extraction splits 'Company: Job Title' format and safely handles listings without colon delimiter.
Skills, location regions/countries, remote status, employment type, and descriptions are sanitized (HTML and script tags stripped) and normalized to canonical search semantics.
Single job fetch retrieves and normalizes specific job postings by posting slug.
Client-side category and search term filtering operate over the full feed inventory.
Registry source_adapter recognizes provider 'wwr' and configure_source supports 'wwr' with persistent job source configuration.
Operation cancellation callbacks are polled during rate-limit sleep and request execution.
Bounded live read-only validation successfully verified against the live public RSS feed without bypasses or circumventions.

local_checks.summary: 21 tests passed in 9.9s covering WWR adapter capabilities, search contract, multi-company attribution, normalization, single-job fetch, error handling/health, cancellation, client-side filtering, and live bounded verification.
57 integration tests passed in 24.4s across Greenhouse, Remotive, and We Work Remotely discovery sources.
13 test files, 62 frontend tests passed in 367ms.

notes: Tests and builds executed in isolated worktree C:\Tools\Dev\MJobs\.worktrees\antigravity-mj-req017-s02-wwr-20261006.
Local-only policy strictly followed; hosted CI and Actions disabled.

limitations: We Work Remotely public RSS feed does not support direct resume/application submission; application redirect URL is provided.
WWR RSS does not support server-side query filtering; category and search term filters are evaluated client-side.
Parent MJ-REQ-017 remains open until other job source adapters are completed.
